summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, proxy statement, and proxy card. The meeting is scheduled for June 16, 2026, with standard agenda items: re-election and election of directors, approval of bonus plans for executive officers and controlling shareholder, approval of amended compensation policy, and reappointment of auditors. The board recommends voting for all proposals except those in which the controlling shareholder has a personal interest (resolutions 2-4). No special-situation corporate event is present; this is a routine meeting notice for a foreign private issuer.
